conclusion: With only the training label changed (raw official return -> official return minus the full-timestamp training-pool mean, raw-label target_std kept), the seed-mean paired daily all-eight-time RankIC difference against the retained raw-label 10-day/1500 reference was +0.043121 against the unchanged floor of 0.011647; per window research_a: +0.060710, research_b: +0.025531. Seed 11 progress was +0.025159 and is not part of the decision. Error reporting, kept separate from ranking: research_a: raw-label MSE 1.032584e-05, centered-label MSE 8.785327e-06, training centered loss 1.240359e-05 (seed 11); research_b: raw-label MSE 1.551679e-05, centered-label MSE 1.129793e-05, training centered loss 1.483013e-05 (seed 11). The candidate fails the predeclared gates worst_day_guardrail, so the raw-label 10-day reference is retained. The three seeds are complete; this is not evidence that every cross-sectional label transform is uninformative.

recovery.reason: The six fits and inferences completed, but the original archive failed while writing the diagnostic centered-label report: float32 subtraction collapsed two near-tied labels and changed one day's rank IC. The diagnostic now centers in float64. No model is retrained.

research_a.interpretation: Both arms use 1500 x 32 = 48,000 sample exposures on the same 10 training dates and seeds; only the training-label definition differs.

research_b.interpretation: Both arms use 1500 x 32 = 48,000 sample exposures on the same 10 training dates and seeds; only the training-label definition differs.

policy.exposure_policy: Steps, batch size, learning rate and recipe stay fixed for this round; a larger pool gets no extra steps because that would confound coverage with compute.
policy.interpretation_rule: A non-accept result bounds what equal-compute date expansion achieves; it does not establish that more history is uninformative.
policy.primary_metric: paired daily all-eight-time RankIC, seed-mean per day before pairing

statistics.sensitivity_rule: Report both block lengths; conflicting conclusions are inconclusive, and neither is chosen after seeing results.

gates.thresholds_status: copied unchanged from the frozen 20261017 v4 calibration

hypothesis: The raw-label 10-day/1500 reference spends capacity fitting a market-wide level that its cross-sectional LOB inputs cannot predict. Subtracting the full-timestamp training-pool mean removes that unlearnable component while keeping the raw-label target_std, so the MSE should focus on relative returns and improve out-of-sample RankIC under the unchanged gates.

label_centering.assumption_status: minimal unverified assumption for this project; the public precedent does not establish that demean-only labels improve this model
label_centering.cross_section: one complete timestamp of the frozen 10-day training pool, all stocks and all eight sample times; never a random mini-batch
label_centering.evaluation: official raw labels for every reported ranking, long-short, turnover and raw MSE; a centered-label diagnostic is reported separately and never selects the model
label_centering.formula: y* = official return - group mean by full timestamp over the selected training pool
label_centering.inference: direct relative score from the fitted network times the raw-label target_std; no label read and no future timestamp mean added back

research_a.formula: official return - mean official return over every training stock at the same full timestamp
research_a.scope: every selected training row of each full timestamp; computed once before mini-batches and before the min-history mask
research_a.target_std_basis: raw official training label standard deviation (not the centered standard deviation)

research_b.formula: official return - mean official return over every training stock at the same full timestamp
research_b.scope: every selected training row of each full timestamp; computed once before mini-batches and before the min-history mask
research_b.target_std_basis: raw official training label standard deviation (not the centered standard deviation)

public_precedent.use: Qlib applies cross-sectional processors per datetime; this round borrows only the per-timestamp mean subtraction and does not claim an equivalent validated label recipe.

limitations: Two research windows and three seeds are selection data, not independent confirmation.
Demeaning only is a minimal assumption with a public cross-sectional-processing precedent; this round does not establish that it is the best label transform or that it works elsewhere.
The target_std remains the raw-label standard deviation by design, so the centered and raw arms share one scale rather than an optimally rescaled centered target.
Raw-label MSE and centered-label MSE measure different targets; neither replaces the official competition score.
Confirmation, locked and legacy final ranges were not opened; the platform time and memory limits remain unverified.
next_steps: If rejected, test a different scaling basis or label transform only after a new pre-registration; do not retune this round after seeing its result.
If accepted, run a separately frozen confirmation on untouched dates before any platform claim.
only_factor: training label raw official return -> official return minus the mean official return over every training stock at the same full timestamp; target_std stays the raw-label std; network, inputs, 1500 steps, batch order, MSE, seeds and dates fixed

recipe_fixed.target_std_fit: raw official selected training labels, full 10-day pool

reference_source.note: The six raw-label fits completed; that run failed only after training while writing its analysis. Its own prediction files and the completed analysis-recovery archive are reused.

research_b.interpretation: Both arms use 1500 x 32 = 48,000 sample exposures on the same 10 training dates and seeds; only the training-label definition differs.

decision.interpretation: A non-accept result rejects the claim that full-timestamp label demeaning improves the retained raw-label 10-day/1500 reference under the unchanged gates. It does not show that every cross-sectional label transform or target scale is uninformative.
decision.limitations: Two research windows and three seeds are selection data; local gross metrics exclude fees and slippage; the platform time and memory limits remain unverified.
decision.only_factor: training label raw official return -> official return minus the mean official return over every training stock at the same full timestamp; target_std stays the raw-label std; network, inputs, 1500 steps, batch order, MSE, seeds and dates fixed
